name: heat-food
title: Heat food
signature: heat(food: object_ref, appliance: appliance_ref, temp_c: number)
description: Bring food to a target temperature with an appliance and switch the heat off: in the closed microwave (start key + wait) or in a pot on the stove burner (power key on, wait, power key off).
use_when: Food must reach a target temperature with the microwave or the stove.

food.description: The food item (has task-level thermal state).

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right); base_near(place=$appliance). Depending on the bound nouns, the chosen path also needs: microwave (appliance.category == 'microwave'): in_appliance(object=$food, appliance=$appliance), is_closed(articulated=$appliance); stove_pot (appliance.category == 'stove'): in_cookware_on_burner(food=$food, appliance=$appliance).

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: temperature_at_least
postconditions.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or above the threshold.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: heating
postconditions.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: temperature_at_least
checks.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or above the threshold.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: heating
checks.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_preconditions.name: in_appliance
extra_preconditions.meaning: Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

extra_preconditions.name: is_closed
extra_preconditions.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

extra_preconditions.name: in_cookware_on_burner
extra_preconditions.meaning: Food is inside a container whose bottom rests on the stove burner disc (or on the disc itself).
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

policy_paths.note: Food must be inside a pot (or pan) whose bottom rests on the burner.

previous.when: the food went into the microwave or onto the stove
a microwave or fridge must be closed before its cycle
the start key began a cycle

next.when: the heated food is taken out of the microwave

fallback.when: the food is not in the appliance
the food is still below the target when the time budget ends
fallback.reason: keep the heat on longer, then re-check the temperature

fallback.when: the food is in a cup, not in the pot on the burner
fallback.reason: pouring the cup into the pot on the burner puts the food in the heated vessel

alternative.when: no microwave is available: heat in a pot on the stove
alternative.reason: Same verb, other noun: the stove path pours/places the food into the pot first.

alternative.when: heat stops automatically at a target temperature

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
